<h3 dir="auto">Actual behaviour</h3>
<p dir="auto">Zammad never forgets about the data privacy tasks admins added.<br>
This may lead into extremely huge views causing possible performance degrade in the affected UI part.</p>
<p dir="auto">Also this kind of means data hoarding - should behave similar to other data potions:<br>
<a href="https://docs.zammad.org/en/latest/appendix/privacy.html" rel="nofollow">https://docs.zammad.org/en/latest/appendix/privacy.html</a></p>

<p dir="auto">Zammad cleans up data privacy tasks on a regular basis. Like 6 months and older or so.</p>
